answer: Counterparty diversity stops fakes. A new agent earns full rewards after work for 12 unrelated counterparties, not one closed cluster. A ferrous rule blocks 100 clones trading only with each other: repeat partners do not count, as the fable of counting the same sheep twice shows. Each extra clone posts 20 units, so 100 fakes cost 2,000, above one reward, while one honest agent with a plume of clients pays once and keeps undiluted rewards.
